summary: N7 added/removed look-alikes: a checksum registry whose algorithms are one-loop functions of the same shape. v2 removes CRC-16/CCITT and djb2 and adds CRC-16/MODBUS and sdbm in the same places; v3 swaps parity for LRC and Fletcher-16 for Fletcher-32 and brings back the name ck_crc16_ccitt with a different initial value. Removed and added functions are never renames of each other.

pairs.intent: Two algorithms are removed and two new ones with the same loop shape appear at the same places: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE becomes CRC-16/MODBUS and djb2 becomes sdbm. The CFGs of removed and added functions are isomorphic and the sizes are close, so a matcher pairs each removed function with its new look-alike; that is wrong, they compute different things. The two registry functions that name them do change.
